entities.summary: Edward Ferrero was one of the leading dance instructors, choreographers, and ballroom operators in the United States and served as a Union Army general in the American Civil War, being most remembered for his conduct unbecoming in the Battle of the Crater, where he was reported to have been drinking with another general behind the lines as both their units were virtually destroyed.
